questions.prompt: The witness gave a ___ account, including every small detail.
questions.explanation: “Detailed” means including many facts or particulars.

questions.prompt: If I ___ about the road closure, I would have taken another route.
questions.explanation: This is a third conditional: If + past perfect, would have + past participle.

questions.prompt: Kai practised quietly each day instead of boasting about his skills. What can you infer?
options: He wants others to do all the work.
questions.explanation: Regular practice suggests that Kai focuses on improving his skills.

questions.prompt: The speaker gave a “reluctant” reply and looked away. Which meaning best fits “reluctant”?
questions.explanation: The context suggests the speaker was hesitant to respond.

questions.prompt: The glass ornament was so ___ that we handled it carefully.
questions.explanation: “Fragile” means easily broken and fits the context.

questions.prompt: If she had left earlier, she ___ the bus.
questions.explanation: The third conditional uses “would have” plus a past participle.

questions.prompt: The boy ___ won the race is my cousin.
questions.explanation: Use “who” to refer to a person.

questions.prompt: Although the team was exhausted, they continued practising because the final was the next day. What motivated them?
options: They wanted to prepare for the final
They wanted to avoid their coach
questions.explanation: The upcoming final explains why they continued practising.

questions.prompt: An article compares reusable bottles with single-use plastic bottles and highlights waste reduction. What is the writer mainly trying to do?
questions.explanation: The comparison and emphasis on reducing waste support reusable bottles.

questions.prompt: A character returned a lost wallet without taking anything. Which trait is best supported?
questions.explanation: Returning the wallet untouched is evidence of honesty.
